nodes.description: Constant address of the vault contract called in performUpkeep via low-level call.
Constant address of the dripper contract invoked with collectAndRebase() via low-level call.
Constant privileged owner address checked in setConfig for authorization.
Immutable uint24 start of the daily execution window in seconds.
Immutable uint24 end of the daily execution window in seconds.
Mutable uint256 storing the last day the keeper ran, guarding once-per-day execution.
Public bytes32 bitmask schedule of rebase/allocate days, writable by owner.
Constructor initializing windowStart, windowEnd and config from arguments.
External function updating config; guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
External view keeper hook returning whether upkeep is needed using _shouldRun.
External keeper hook performing low-level calls to dripper and vault and writing lastRunDay.
Internal view computing runRebase/runAllocate from time, window and config bits.
Caller-controlled address used as the authorization check against owner in setConfig.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp used for day computation and window checks.
Low-level dripper.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("collectAndRebase()")) with unchecked return value.
Low-level vault.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("allocate()")) with unchecked return value.
Parameter config_ of setConfig assigned to state variable config.
Constructor parameter windowStart_ assigned to immutable windowStart.
Constructor parameter windowEnd_ assigned to immutable windowEnd.
Constructor parameter config_ assigned to state variable config.
Calldata checkData passed through as performData in checkUpkeep.
Calldata performData argument of performUpkeep, unused in logic.
Local uint256 day = block.timestamp / 86400 used in _shouldRun.
Local uint8 weekday = (day + 4) % 7 used for config bit lookup in _shouldRun.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to owner in setConfig require, making authorization caller-dependent.
block.timestamp controls lastRunDay write and hence timing of privileged keeper actions.
block.timestamp determines day and daySeconds, controlling whether upkeep runs in the window.
_shouldRun reads lastRunDay to decide if upkeep already ran today.
_shouldRun reads config bits to determine rebase and allocate days.
_shouldRun compares daySeconds against windowStart.
_shouldRun compares daySeconds against windowEnd.
checkUpkeep invokes _shouldRun to compute upkeepNeeded.
performUpkeep invokes _shouldRun to decide which keeper actions to execute.
performUpkeep writes lastRunDay to enforce once-per-day execution.
performUpkeep performs an external low-level call to the dripper contract with an unchecked result.
performUpkeep performs an external low-level call to the vault contract with an unchecked result.
setConfig writes the config state variable and emits ConfigUpdated.
setConfig relies on the constant owner address for authorization.
Constructor assigns windowStart_ argument to immutable windowStart.
Constructor assigns windowEnd_ argument to immutable windowEnd.
Constructor assigns config_ argument to state variable config.
windowStart_ parameter is consumed by the constructor assignment.
windowEnd_ parameter is consumed by the constructor assignment.
config_ constructor parameter is consumed by the config assignment.
config_ parameter is consumed by setConfig when writing config.
checkData parameter is forwarded as performData in checkUpkeep.
performData parameter is passed into performUpkeep entry point.
local day is computed inside _shouldRun from block.timestamp.
local weekday is derived in _shouldRun for config bit shifting.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter config_ of setConfig flows directly into the setConfig function state write.
Constructor parameter windowStart_ is only used to initialize the constructor.
Constructor parameter windowEnd_ is only used to initialize the constructor.
Constructor parameter config_ is only used to initialize the constructor.
checkData parameter belongs to and is forwarded by checkUpkeep.
performData parameter belongs to the performUpkeep entry function.
local day is a computed scalar local to _shouldRun.
local weekday is a computed scalar local to _shouldRun.
